manifestoSection.headline: Great food isn't found in guidebooks. It's found down a side street your grandmother remembers.
manifestoSection.tagline: We don't just show you where to eat. We connect you to the people, the history, and the soul behind every dish.
manifestoSection.body: Malaysia's food heritage is vanishing — stalls close, recipes are lost, neighbourhoods change. We exist to preserve it by giving our guests an authentic taste of what makes Malaysian food culture extraordinary. Every tour supports the vendors who have been keeping these traditions alive for decades.

pillars.label: People
pillars.heading: Heritage Vendors
pillars.body: We work with multi-generational vendors who have been perfecting their craft for decades. Meeting them is the heart of every tour.

pillars.label: Food
pillars.heading: Authentic Flavours
pillars.body: From street-side char kuey teow to hand-rolled roti canai, every dish tells a story of Malaysia's rich culinary heritage.

pillars.label: Place
pillars.heading: Cultural Context
pillars.body: Explore neighbourhoods that tourists rarely see, with guides who grew up in them. History, architecture, and hidden gems included.
